user_input: 画一条正弦曲线 y=sin(x)，x 范围 0 到 2pi，用 PGFPlots 代码实现，并尽量美观
ai_response:
```latex
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
    width=12cm, height=6.8cm,
    axis lines=middle,
    xlabel={$x$（弧度 rad）},
    ylabel={$y$},
    xmin=0, xmax=6.9,
    ymin=-1.4, ymax=1.45,
    domain=0:2*pi,
    samples=300,
    xtick={0,pi/2,pi,3*pi/2,2*pi},
    xticklabels={$0$,$\frac{\pi}{2}$,$\pi$,$\frac{3\pi}{2}$,$2\pi$},
    ytick={-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1},
    yticklabels={$-1$,$-0.5$,$0$,$0.5$,$1$},
    grid=major,
    grid style={gray!25, dashed},
    tick label style={font=\small},
    label style={font=\small},
    legend style={at={(1.03,0.5)}, anchor=west, draw=black, fill=white, font=\small, cells={anchor=west}},
    every axis plot/.append style={line width=1pt}
]
% 曲线下方的浅色填充（不进入图例）
\addplot[blue!12, draw=none, samples=200] {sin(deg(x))} \closedcycle;

% 正弦曲线主图
\addplot[blue!70!black, thick] {sin(deg(x))};
\addlegendentry{$y=\sin x$}

% 关键点：极大值、零点、极小值
\addplot[only marks, mark=*, mark size=2.2pt, red!75!black,
         nodes near coords,
         every node near coord/.append style={font=\scriptsize, fill=none, draw=none, inner sep=1pt, anchor=south}]
    coordinates {(pi/2,1) (pi,0) (3*pi/2,-1) (2*pi,0)};
\addlegendentry{极值点与零点}

\node[anchor=north east, font=\scriptsize, text=gray]
    at (axis description cs:1.0,-0.22)
    {函数图像：$y=\sin x$，定义域 $x\in[0,2\pi]$；相位单位为弧度（rad），$\pi\approx3.14159$};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
```
